items.title: Implement fix for reproduced failure
items.userSees: After dev_finish on a DEV story, the story is in REVIEW with a freshly minted currentReviewRound, a phase_transition process-event whose toPhase is REVIEW, and no event mislabeled TEST.

happy.desc: dev_finish on a completed DEV story routes through runStoryTransition: phase=REVIEW, currentReviewRound minted, phase_transition event toPhase=REVIEW.

edge.desc: dev_merge also routes through runStoryTransition (second bypass door closed).

adversarial.desc: neither handler writes story.phase directly; no TEST-mislabeled event is produced.

verificationEvidence.note: transition-integrity smoke (79 checks): dev_finish routes through runStoryTransition — phase=REVIEW, currentReviewRound minted, phase_transition toPhase=REVIEW. RED red-s1-devfinish-bypass.mjs 4/4 FAIL on baseline -> GREEN.
transition-integrity smoke (79 checks): dev_merge also routes through runStoryTransition (second bypass door closed), no raw phase-write. RED red-s1-devfinish-bypass.mjs GREEN.

transition-integrity smoke (79 checks): neither handler writes story.phase directly and no TEST-mislabeled event is produced (toPhase=REVIEW; labels INIT/REVIEW). RED red-s1-devfinish-bypass.mjs GREEN.

items.title: Serialize same-owner concurrent transitions with a per-story transition lock
items.context: Hold a per-story transition lock across read, gate, and persist in runStoryTransition so two concurrent same-owner DEV to REVIEW attempts cannot both act on the same pre-transition state and double-mint review rounds.
items.userSees: Two concurrent DEV to REVIEW transitions for the same story produce exactly one review round and one phase_transition event; the second observes the committed transition.

happy.desc: two concurrent same-owner DEV->REVIEW transitions produce exactly one currentReviewRound and one phase_transition event.

edge.desc: the losing transition observes the committed post-transition state, not a stale re-mint.

adversarial.desc: a transition that throws mid-critical-section releases the lock (no deadlock); DONE still uses only the main write lock.

verificationEvidence.note: transition-integrity smoke (79 checks): two concurrent same-owner DEV->REVIEW transitions produce exactly one currentReviewRound and one phase_transition event; CHK-002a spawns 2 real concurrent procs — 5/5 double-mint without the lock, 1 with.
transition-integrity smoke (79 checks): the losing transition observes the committed post-transition state, not a stale re-mint (per-story transition lock held across read/gate/persist).

transition-integrity smoke (79 checks): a transition that throws mid-critical-section releases the lock (no deadlock); ownership-checked release never deletes a successor dir (CHK-002d/d2/d3) and the F-017 mismatch-restore leak is bounded + stale-reclaimable (CHK-002d4).
